name: rclone
description: Rclone cloud-storage manager with a browser-based GUI and remote-control API

fields.name: RCLONE_HOST
fields.label: R1: NAS IP Address or Hostname
fields.help:
IP address or hostname your browser uses to reach this NAS, without http:// or a port. It is inserted into Rclone's special login URL so the browser can connect to both the GUI and API.
Example: 10.30.30.195. Replace the example with your own NAS address.
Important: Rclone does not use a normal GUI address alone. After deployment, use EasyDocker's Open Rclone GUI button, which constructs the required URL in this format:
http://NAS-IP:5522/login?pass=PASSWORD&url=http%3A%2F%2FNAS-IP%3A5533%2F&user=USERNAME

fields.name: GUI_PORT
fields.label: R2: GUI Port
fields.help:
Host port for Rclone's browser interface in bridge mode. In Host Mode, the GUI listens directly on NAS port 5522.
Do not treat http://NAS-IP:5522/ like an ordinary application URL. Use EasyDocker's Open Rclone GUI button so the login URL also includes the authenticated API address.

fields.name: API_PORT
fields.label: R3: API Port
fields.help:
Host port for Rclone's authenticated remote-control API in bridge mode. The browser GUI needs this connection.
Security: Do not expose this port to the internet. Restrict access to your trusted local network or VPN.

fields.name: GUI_USERNAME
fields.label: R4: GUI Username
fields.help: Username used by both the Rclone GUI and remote-control API.

fields.name: GUI_PASSWORD
fields.label: R5: GUI Password
fields.help:
Generated password used by the Rclone GUI and API. Save it securely.
The automatic login URL includes this password in its query string, as required by Rclone, so avoid sharing the URL or exposing it in screenshots and browser history on untrusted devices.

fields.name: CONFIG_LOCATION
fields.label: R6: Config Folder
fields.help:
Host folder containing rclone.conf.
Recommended headless setup: Download Rclone on a Windows PC, run rclone config, and complete the cloud-provider login there. Run rclone config file to display the exact configuration-file location. Copy that rclone.conf file into this NAS folder, then restart the container.

fields.name: DATA_LOCATION
fields.label: R7: Data Folder
fields.help: Host folder exposed inside the container as /data for local uploads, downloads, copies, and synchronization jobs.

fields.name: RCLONE_NETWORK_MODE
fields.label: O1: Network
fields.help: Choose Create New Bridge for the recommended default, Host Mode, or an existing named Docker network. Bridge mode isolates Rclone while publishing only the selected GUI and API ports.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: O2: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether the container restarts automatically.

fields.name: RCLONE_IMAGE
fields.label: A1: Image
fields.help: Official Rclone image. Change this only if you need a pinned version or another image source.

fields.name: RCLONE_MOUNTS_MAPPING
fields.label: A2: Shared Cloud-Mount Folder
fields.help:
Only needed when testing FUSE cloud-drive mounts that must propagate back to the NAS. Enter a full mapping such as ./mounts:/mounts:rshared.
Leave blank for normal GUI, copy, sync, and transfer use. Shared propagation support varies by NAS and host filesystem.

fields.name: RCLONE_FUSE_DEVICE
fields.label: A3: FUSE Device
fields.help: Only enable for cloud-drive mounting. Enter /dev/fuse:/dev/fuse after confirming that /dev/fuse exists on the NAS. Leave blank otherwise.

fields.name: RCLONE_FUSE_CAPABILITY
fields.label: A4: FUSE SYS_ADMIN Capability
fields.help: Enable only for Rclone FUSE mounts. SYS_ADMIN is a powerful capability and is unnecessary for ordinary GUI transfers, copies, or synchronization.

fields.name: RCLONE_FUSE_SECURITY_OPTION
fields.label: A5: FUSE AppArmor Relaxation
fields.help: Enable only when FUSE mounting requires it on your NAS. This disables AppArmor confinement for the container and reduces isolation. Some NAS systems do not use AppArmor and may reject this option.

fields.name: RCLONE_GUI_PORT_MAPPING
fields.label: A6: Bridge GUI Port Mapping
fields.help: Automatically generated for bridge or an existing Docker network and removed in Host Mode.

fields.name: RCLONE_API_PORT_MAPPING
fields.label: A7: Bridge API Port Mapping
fields.help: Automatically generated for bridge or an existing Docker network and removed in Host Mode.

fields.name: RCLONE_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: Container Name
fields.help: EasyDocker sets the container name from the project name.

fields.name: RCLONE_GUI_INTERNAL_PORT
fields.label: Internal GUI Port
fields.help: Recipe-managed Rclone GUI port inside the container.

fields.name: RCLONE_API_INTERNAL_PORT
fields.label: Internal API Port
fields.help: Recipe-managed Rclone API port inside the container.

fields.name: RCLONE_CONFIG_TARGET
fields.label: Config Path Inside Container
fields.help: Recipe-managed internal configuration path.

fields.name: RCLONE_DATA_TARGET
fields.label: Data Path Inside Container
fields.help: Recipe-managed internal local-data path.

fields.name: RCLONE_GUI_COMMAND
fields.label: GUI Command
fields.help: Recipe-managed command that starts Rclone's official GUI.

fields.name: RCLONE_GUI_ADDRESS
fields.label: GUI Listen Address
fields.help: Recipe-managed GUI listen address.

fields.name: RCLONE_API_ADDRESS
fields.label: API Listen Address
fields.help: Recipe-managed API listen address.

fields.name: RCLONE_GUI_USER_ARGUMENT
fields.label: GUI Username Argument
fields.help: Recipe-managed authenticated GUI username argument.

fields.name: RCLONE_GUI_PASSWORD_ARGUMENT
fields.label: GUI Password Argument
fields.help: Recipe-managed authenticated GUI password argument.

fields.name: RCLONE_NO_BROWSER_ARGUMENT
fields.label: Headless Browser Argument
fields.help: Prevents the headless container from attempting to open a local browser.

ui.overview: Rclone connects to many cloud-storage providers and manages transfers, synchronization, browsing, and optional FUSE mounts through its official web GUI.
what_happens: One official Rclone container will be created in headless GUI mode
The GUI will listen on port 5522 and its authenticated API will listen on port 5533 by default
Rclone requires a special login URL containing the GUI credentials and the separate API address; opening only the base GUI port is not sufficient
EasyDocker's Open Rclone GUI link will include the selected username, password, NAS address, and API URL in Rclone's required login format
After deployment, use the Open Rclone GUI button rather than manually opening http://NAS-IP:5522/
The API port should remain accessible only from a trusted local network or VPN and must not be exposed directly to the internet
Rclone configuration will be stored in the selected bind-mounted config folder
For provider authentication, configure Rclone on a Windows PC, locate rclone.conf with rclone config file, and copy it into the NAS config folder
The local data folder will be available inside Rclone as /data
FUSE device access, SYS_ADMIN, shared propagation, and AppArmor relaxation are disabled by default and are only needed for experimental cloud-drive mounting
Bridge networking is selected by default, with Host Mode and existing Docker networks also available
ui.data_location: The config and data folders can be relative to this app's config folder or absolute host paths. Copy the Windows-generated rclone.conf directly into the selected config folder.
